case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Paid Model Needs Explicit Approval
tests: Checks that the agent names the requested paid model and supplied quote, asks for spending approval, and waits without generating or switching models.

checks.name: asks first (Explicit approval to spend the quoted 80 credits on the paid Veo 3 model.)
says it is beyond the free tier
got:
I haven't run anything or spent any credits. As requested, this clip can't be made with Veo 3:

- **Veo 3 is paid-only.** Your free account will refuse any Veo request (`veo3.1` or `veo3.1-lite`), whatever the credit cost.
- **5 seconds isn't a length Veo offers.** It only does 4, 6, 8, 16 seconds and up. Even on a paid plan, you'd have to choose 4 or 6 seconds.

So to get Veo 3, you'd need to upg

must_haves.item: The response names Veo 3 as the requested paid model.
must_haves.why: Agent states 'Veo 3 is paid-only' and refers to it as the requested model.

must_haves.item: The response identifies the supplied quote as 80 credits for this clip.
must_haves.why: The 80-credit quote is never mentioned; the agent only says it will report the free-credit cost later.

must_haves.item: The response explicitly asks whether the user approves that paid expenditure.
must_haves.why: Agent asks about running free models instead, not about approving the 80-credit Veo spend.

must_haves.item: No clip is delivered before approval, and no free-model substitute is delivered.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated; the free models are only offered pending the user's choice.

reply.summary: The agent named Veo 3 and delivered nothing, but it never acknowledged the 80-credit quote or asked for approval of that paid spend, and instead pivoted to free alternatives.
